performance.cable-capacity-basis: Cat6 24AWG cables, theoretical - FS 0U/1U Horizontal Cable Manager datasheet, specification table, third column

physical.mounting-hardware: M6*15mm Screw x4 and M6 Nut x4

configs.description: The cable manager as FS ships #317013, five frames and the cover fitted.
configs.name: base

gaps.note: FS's drawing gives 482 overall and does not mark where the panel's edges fold; the 430 between the folds is FS's figure for its three other flat 1U D-ring panels.
gaps.wanted: a drawing that dimensions the folds, or a ruler on the part

gaps.note: the cover is drawn in an exploded view and in renders only; its length, height, thickness and lip are estimated, and so is how deep the panel's folded edges run.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned section of the cover and the panel
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - the ring material, the mounting hardware, the capacity and "Indoor" are the third column of the 0U/1U datasheet's table. "SPCC" for the panel is FS's product page for #317013, which is not a held document.

cable-capacity.note: datasheet - "Cable Capacity (Theoretical Value) 55pcs (Cat6 24AWG)" in the third column of the 0U/1U datasheet's table, for the whole manager. Stated once, here, and not divided among the frames.

chassis.note: estimated for the 430 and the 88.8; drawing for the 44. The drawing gives 482 overall and does not mark the folds; the body is taken as the 430 between the folded edges that FS dimensions on its other three flat 1U D-ring panels, which leaves the outer frames 10.8 mm inside the folds. THE DEPTH SOURCES DISAGREE, and the drawing settles them: the 0U/1U datasheet's table and the product page's title say 3.14 in (80 mm), the product page's specification table says 3.23 in (82 mm), and the drawing dimensions the frame alone 80. So 80 is the frame without the cover and 82 is the part with it; FS's dimensioned render (gallery image 4) gives both, 3.14 in at the frames and 3.23 in to the face of the cover. The panel's folded edges stand behind that, taken as 8 (estimated, in the flange contract), so the envelope is 88.8.

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black". Every image FS publishes of the part is a render.

front.note: drawing - the front view: four obround windows 71.1 x 30, centred 51 and 153 mm either side of the middle, and a frame at the middle and every 102 mm either side of it, where the drawing puts a pair of clip slots and a round hole; the slot pairs read 102 apart at 1.07 px/mm. The cover is placed over the frames; pulling it shows the channel. FS's mark, printed on the left ear, is outside the body.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the frames and cover stand 82 mm in front of the panel's back, and only the panel's folded edges stand behind it, so the rear face of its rack unit stays free for another part (#854).

left.note: drawing - an elevation, the drawing's frame profile in front of the plate with the cover across its front, and the folded edges behind it. The right is the same, turned round.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE VENDOR'S DRAWING, WHICH IS COARSE. FS's 0U/1U Horizontal Cable Manager datasheet draws this part on its last page: a front view of the panel (482 x 44), the frame's profile (80 x 43.5), the frame from the front (10) and an exploded view with the cover. The front view is 1.0726 px/mm across from the 482 (517 px) and 1.068 down from the 44 (47 px), 0.4 % apart, so it is orthographic; at that scale a pixel is a millimetre. FS's renders (gallery images 1 to 6 and feature images 1 to 4) were used for what the drawing does not dimension.

passes.note: drawing - the four windows, open; the renders show them through to the back. Declared on the rear view, where they open onto the back of the plate: on the front the cover stands 80 mm in front of them, and a pass-through may not lie under a part on its face (L136), which reads the face in two dimensions.

rear.note: estimated - the back of the plate with the four windows through it. FS publishes no image of the back.

thickness.note: estimated - 1.2 mm, the sheet FS dimensions on the CMH-4DRB1U drawing. Nothing dimensions this part's sheet; the material is "SPCC" on the product page.

top.note: estimated - an elevation: the folded edge behind the plate, the frames' upper arms from above and the cover's lip across their fronts. The bottom is the same from underneath, without the lip.

weight.note: datasheet - "Weight 0.9lbs (0.41kg)" in the third column of the 0U/1U datasheet's table. That column is headed CMH-5DR1U, a second time, but carries this part's 3.14 in depth and its weight, and the drawing on the same datasheet's last page is this part's: it is the USCMH-5DR1U column misheaded.
